pages.title: Lucky Wheel
pages.text: The fixed top pointer selects the prize colour.

pages.title: How to play
pages.text: Set a stake and Start; no colour prediction is needed. The wheel slows to a stop beneath the fixed top pointer.$(br2)A colour can occupy several sectors. Its probability combines all pockets of that colour.

pages.title: Event probabilities
pages.text: 40 equally likely pockets:$(br)Grey: 23, 57.5%, ×0$(br)Green: 9, 22.5%, ×1$(br)Blue: 5, 12.5%, ×2$(br)Purple: 2, 5%, ×4$(br)Gold: 1, 2.5%, ×10$(br2)Green returns the stake. Spins are independent; there is no pity system.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Default Lv.3; initial stake cap 50,000. Wallet upgrades can raise it.$(br2)The result settles automatically once.$(br2)Payouts include the stake. Server rules may differ; check the live interface.
Craft, then right-click to use. Machines still require the matching wallet level.
